Declared hypothesis on key dispersion, acceptance region fixed here and hard-asserted on the measured sums of the four trials ('k4 diag'): per F9 claw, D = keys whose shipped entry passes F8 (all 1,319 blocks, 324,324 keys), K = those whose W17 x 2654435761 mod 2^32 has top 7 bits zero; under independent key events K ~ Binomial(D, 2^-7).
